def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    connector = set()
    # Join aligned 1 markers, preserving any other original marker on the segment.
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i+1:]:
            if r1 != r2 and abs(r2-r1) == abs(c2-c1):
                dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
                dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
                for k in range(abs(r2-r1)+1):
                    r, c = r1+dr*k, c1+dc*k
                    connector.add((r,c))
                    if grid[r][c] == bg:
                        out[r][c] = 1
    # A 6 that lies on a 1-connector extends along the perpendicular diagonal to the grid edges.
    for r, c in [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6 and (r,c) in connector]:

                    out[rr][cc] = 6
